title: 海克斯大乱斗 Beta
description:
[h1] Beta Edition / Beta 版物品 [/h1]
本物品仅支持 Slay the Spire 2 的 [b]beta 分支[/b](0.108.0+)。正式版玩家请订阅正式物品「海克斯大乱斗」。
This item only supports the [b]beta branch[/b] of Slay the Spire 2 (0.108.0+). For the default branch, please subscribe to the main item.

[h1] Supported Languages / 支持语言 [/h1]
English
简体中文
한국어

[h1] Introduction [/h1]
This mod adds a Hextech Rune system to Slay the Spire 2, inspired by League of Legends. It is a popular large-scale expansion mod for Slay the Spire 2.

There are currently 145 Hextech Runes with a wide variety of effects. On each floor, players can choose one random Hextech Rune, while monsters will also randomly receive a Hextech of the same rarity. Both sides will fight under constantly changing rules.

The mod also adds character-specific Hextechs, stat forges, brand-new cards, and statistics feedback, giving every run different build paths and challenge pacing.
